cap_confirmation: driver state level_cap 96; offset-1 members L95, Victreebel offset 2 L96.
chronology_note: Same audit as E0482 (party_vr96_b); two reachable legends (Chi-Yu, Landorus), no window-90 addition used.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Drought on entry; Eruption at full HP turn 1
Venusaur Chlorophyll speed and Sleep Powder / Giga Drain
Zamazenta Dauntless Shield, Iron Defense + Body Press
Mega Victreebel Weather Ball in sun

attempts.why: Sun live at turn 0. Turn 1 Prankster Taunt beat the Chlorophyll Venusaur to its Sleep Powder; sun Heat Wave OHKO'd Venusaur and took Torkoal to 163; full-HP Eruption put Whimsicott on its Sash (250) and chipped Chi-Yu. Turn 2 Prankster Tailwind, then Heat Wave KO'd both Torkoal and Heliolisk before either moved (Heliolisk had chosen Thunderbolt). Turn 3 Taunt on Zamazenta (Iron Defense denied); Accelerock hit the incoming Urshifu, Body Press KO'd the 1-HP Whimsicott. Turn 4 Close Combat KO'd Lycanroc, Earth Power crit took Zamazenta to 76, Body Press KO'd the -1 Def Urshifu. Turn 5 Mega Fake Out + Earth Power KO'd Zamazenta as the sun and tailwind expired; Victreebel Mega Evolved and was KO'd by Double-Edge + Earth Power before it could use the (now sunless) Weather Ball. Faints: Whimsicott, Urshifu.

strategy_checks.evidence: turn 1 Eruption: 250 on Whimsicott (Sash), 60 on Chi-Yu (resisted)
Venusaur moved before Chi-Yu and chose Sleep Powder into Chi-Yu; 'can't use Sleep Powder after the taunt'
Thunderbolt chosen turn 2, KO'd under the player's Tailwind before moving; Glare never used
turns 3-4 Accelerock priority (44 on Urshifu resisted, 83 on Landorus)

strategy_checks.check: Zamazenta Dauntless Shield / Iron Defense + Body Press
strategy_checks.result: PASS (Shield, Body Press), Iron Defense denied by Taunt
strategy_checks.evidence: def+1 on entry; Body Press KO'd Whimsicott (t3) and Urshifu (t4, 284)
Mega Evolved on turn 5 as the sun ended; KO'd before acting

protect_ledger.payoff: empty in effect - nothing was aimed at it (both attacks went into Zamazenta); it burned its safe turn while the sun expired

ai_notes: Zamazenta targeted correctly both turns (the KO on the 1-HP Whimsicott, then the -1 Def Urshifu). Victreebel Protecting on its entry turn while the last sun turn ticked away cost it its only Weather Ball window; not illegal.
level_change_rationale: Won first try after a real fight with 2 faints (Eruption Sash break, two Body Press KOs). Keep.
cooler: The sun-fast half died to its own sun again (Heat Wave off a Fire attacker is boosted by Drought), which is the structural cost of both sun doors; Zamazenta was the memorable piece exactly as the dossier says - it took two Pokemon. No set change; the Taunt vulnerability of Sleep Powder/Iron Defense is the intended crack.
